title: Privacy policy
excerpt: What this website records about visitors, why, and how to have it removed.

fields.lead: What this website records about visitors, why, and how to have it removed.

props.text: This website is run by Emre, a software engineer. He decides what is recorded and is the person to write to: [emre@swemre.com](mailto:emre@swemre.com).
When you visit, the site records the page you opened, the page you came from and a random session id kept in your browser. It does not set tracking cookies.

facts.label: Page views
facts.value: Path, referrer and a random session id

facts.label: Forms
facts.value: What you type in the contact and call back forms

facts.label: Newsletter
facts.value: Your name, email and the topics you picked

props.title: No tracking cookies
props.text: No third-party advertising or analytics scripts are used on this site.
Page views are kept for 12 months, then removed automatically. Form messages, requests and newsletter details are kept until you ask for them to be deleted or you unsubscribe.

props.text: You can ask for a copy of your data, or for it to be corrected or deleted, at any time. Write to [emre@swemre.com](mailto:emre@swemre.com) and Emre replies personally, usually within a few days.

facts.label: Get a copy
facts.value: Everything stored about you, sent by email.

facts.label: Correct it
facts.value: Fix details that are wrong or out of date.

facts.label: Delete it
facts.value: Remove your form messages, requests and newsletter details.

props.text: When this policy changes, the version number and the date at the top of this page change with it. The current version is 1.3, effective 15 October 2026.

props.text: Questions about this policy or your data? Write to [emre@swemre.com](mailto:emre@swemre.com), or use the [contact form](/contact).
